newsitem.title: UK: Huntington signs a $2.0 billion debt programme.
newsitem.headline: Huntington signs a $2.0 billion debt programme.

text.p: Huntington Bancshares Inc (HBI) and the Huntington National Bank (HNB) has signed a $2.0 billion programme for the issuance of debt instruments, the arranger Morgan Stanley & Co International said in a statement on Friday.

HBI is a multi-state bank holding company based in Columbus, Ohio. HNB is its principal subsidiary and a national banking association with a focus on consumer lending and loans to small and middle-market communities.
HBI is rated A3/A- and HNB is rated A1/A by Moody's Investor Services and Standard & Poor's Ratings Services respectively.
The programme is listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange.
